title: Moore Police Officer Tases and Body-Slams Suspect Who Broke into a Home
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Moore, Oklahoma — On June 5, 2025, Moore Police Officers responded to a house where a man, identified as Jason Girod, was reportedly inside without the homeowner's permission. Officers attempted to detain him on active warrants, but things turned full WWE. Girod asked what the warrants were for and refused to be detained by officers. Officers can be heard multiple times warning that they would taser Girod. When he still refused to comply, officers tased him. When he continued to resist, police threw him to the ground. Girod  was arrested and booked for breaking and entering, resisting arrest, and for his outstanding warrants.
